title: Policy-year ordinals declare anniversary and overlap conventions
question: Distinguish integer elapsed anniversaries from one-based policy duration and year fractions; compare equality, reversed dates and leap anniversaries.

evidence.title: Anniversary count and policy-year ordinal use separate endpoint policies
explanation: years_between compares year/month/day with overlap flag; policy_duration always uses overlaptrue and adds1. Issue date therefore maps to policyyear1 while years_between returns0. Reversal need not negate partial-year count, and leap-day anniversaries depend on day-component comparison rather than calendar-year clipping.
Static read of Utilities only. **This behavior is not currently defined by FinKore Core.** Do not equate policy ordinal, elapsed-year fraction and interest accrual.
